milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the chiseled_stone_bricks and face toward them to demonstrate visual observation. The chiseled_stone_bricks pillar is at spawn-relative [8, 1, 8] inside a stone brick building. max_distance=5 ensures the player must be at or inside the building entrance (entrance is at z=5, target at z=8, so distance from entrance is ~2.5 blocks — well within range). From spawn (~11.3 blocks away), the milestone cannot be triggered without approaching. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the target block, not just standing nearby.
